name: Hornero Network Scope
description: Network Scope: a desktop instrument over the shared network provider: download and upload oscilloscopes with stated scales, current rates, Wi-Fi signal and session totals. Real telemetry only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Initial release: cue-toned download and upload oscilloscopes over the shared Telemetry history, Wi-Fi signal meter and session totals (PluginKit 3 desktop widget).

showSessionTotals.description: Show the downloaded/uploaded totals since the shell started.

showNetworkName.description: Show the Wi-Fi network name (personal data; off by default on an always-visible desktop widget).
